name: Menubar
summary: The application menu row (File, Edit, View), Desk's menu bar. Menu titles that open DropdownMenu style menus, arrow keys across the row in reading order, and a status slot at the end.
useWhen: A desktop style app with many commands grouped under a few titles, such as a board editor or the Desk shell
Commands people look for by name and learn by their shortcuts
The top row of an app window, once, with a clock or a save state at the end
avoidWhen: Navigation between pages of a site
A few actions on one object
Phone layouts, where the row has no room and nothing is found by hover
More than one menu row on a screen

value.description: Menubar: the value of the open MenubarMenu, "" when none is open. Controlled, with onValueChange.

defaultValue.description: Menubar: the menu open at first. Default none.

onValueChange.description: Menubar: called with the value of the menu that opens, or "" when it closes.

size.description: Menubar: the row height (size.control.sm or size.control.md), the trigger height and type size, and the size of every menu (rows of 24px, or menu.item.height).

loop.description: Menubar: ArrowRight on the last title goes to the first, and back.

aria-label.description: Menubar: names the row, for example Application menu.

MenubarMenu.value.description: The value Menubar value and onValueChange use for this menu. Default a generated id.

MenubarTrigger.description: The menu title, role menuitem with aria-haspopup menu. A short noun. disabled keeps it in the row, skipped by the arrow keys.

side.description: MenubarContent: where the menu opens, in logical words. It flips when there is no room.

align.description: MenubarContent: how the menu lines up with its trigger. start is the trigger's inline start edge.

sideOffset.description: MenubarContent: the gap to the trigger in px.

collisionPadding.description: MenubarContent and MenubarSubContent: the space kept from the viewport edge in px. A long menu scrolls inside.

MenubarItem.tone.description: An item's tone. danger marks a destructive action; the label names what is destroyed.

start.description: Items and the sub trigger: leading content, a system icon name or a node. Decorative: the text names the item. Rows without it line their text up with rows that have it.

end.description: Items: trailing content, a system icon name or a node. MenubarEnd: the status slot at the inline end of the row (text, not controls).

shortcut.description: Items: a key hint shown at the inline end as plain text, left to right in every language (for example Ctrl+D). It does not bind the key; the app does.

disabled.description: Items and MenubarTrigger: aria-disabled and data-disabled. Skipped by the arrow keys, drawn with opacity.disabled.

onSelect.description: Items: runs on click, Enter and Space, then the menu closes. Call event.preventDefault() to keep it open.

checked.description: MenubarCheckboxItem, with onCheckedChange. The check icon shows it, a minus for indeterminate.

MenubarRadioGroup.value.description: With onValueChange: the chosen MenubarRadioItem value.

textValue.description: Items: the text typeahead matches. Default: the label when it is plain text.

MenubarSub.description: A submenu: a MenubarSubTrigger, then a MenubarSubContent; open, defaultOpen and onOpenChange.

a11y.role: menubar on the root, named with aria-label. Each trigger is a menuitem with aria-haspopup menu and aria-expanded, and names its menu. The menus are role menu, not modal: the page stays in the accessibility tree. The end slot has role none.
a11y.focus: The row is one tab stop: Tab reaches the current title, the arrow keys move between titles. A menu opened with the keyboard puts focus on its first item; on close, focus returns to its title.

keys.Tab: Moves into the row, onto one title, and out again; the row is one tab stop
keys.ArrowRight: Moves to the next title in reading order; with a menu open, opens the next menu. In right to left layouts this is ArrowLeft. In a menu, on a sub trigger, opens the submenu
keys.ArrowLeft: Moves to the previous title in reading order; with a menu open, opens the previous menu. In right to left layouts this is ArrowRight
keys.ArrowDown: On a title, opens its menu with focus on the first item. In a menu, moves to the next item
keys.ArrowUp: In a menu, moves to the previous item
keys.Enter: On a title, opens its menu. On an item, selects it and closes the menu
keys.Home: Moves to the first title, or the first item in a menu
keys.End: Moves to the last title, or the last item in a menu
keys.Escape: Closes the open menu and returns focus to its title
keys.Typeahead: Typing letters moves to the title or item whose label starts with them

a11y.announce: The row is read as a menu bar with its name. Each title reads its label, that it has a popup and whether it is expanded. Items read as in DropdownMenu.
notes: The current menu is shown by two cues, never color alone (WCAG 1.4.1): its title takes the open fill and the open weight. The title reserves the width of its open weight, so the row never shifts.
Arrow keys follow the reading direction: Radix reads the direction from Theme.
The end slot holds status text (a clock, a save state). Controls go in their own row or toolbar, outside role menubar.
At narrow widths the row wraps onto a second line instead of scrolling sideways (WCAG 1.4.10).
Each menu is a dropdown-menu root carrying the part name content, drawn by DropdownMenu.css; its items are DropdownMenu parts.

Contract keys: ArrowRight, ArrowLeft and ArrowDown are checked on a title of the variants case; Escape on an item of the menu that the open case shows at load. The other keys are covered by the unit tests.

en.trigger: A short noun in sentence case: File, Edit, View, Help. No verbs, no icons alone.
en.items: Verb plus noun: Save board, Close window. A shortcut in the shortcut prop.
en.end: Status, not a call to act: Thu 12 Nov 9:41, Saved.
en.count: Up to 10 titles; up to 12 entries in each menu.

ar.trigger: Noun forms, white Saudi dialect, no diacritics: الملف، التحرير، العرض، المساعدة.
ar.items: Noun form labels: حفظ اللوحة، إغلاق النافذة.

react.note: The menus are portaled into a Theme layer marked data-menu-layer menubar, which DropdownMenu.css reads for the Radix menubar measures.

native.note: No application menu row on phones; use a header with a DropdownMenu.

styles.studio: A flat row in color.material.menubar with a hairline under it. Titles in the menu weight; the open title takes the overlay 20 fill and the bold weight.
styles.desk: The macOS style glass row: color.material.menubar with the window blur, regular weight titles that open at semibold, the field radius. Solid under reduced transparency and more contrast.
styles.liquid: Planned: the glass row, with the menus never on top of other glass.

mistakes.wrong: A Menubar as the navigation of a website
mistakes.right: NavigationMenu or links in a header

mistakes.wrong: The open menu shown only by a color change on its title
mistakes.right: The open fill and the open weight, as Menubar draws it

mistakes.wrong: Buttons or a search field inside the row
mistakes.right: Status text in MenubarEnd; controls in a Toolbar next to the row

mistakes.wrong: Verbs as titles: Edit things, View options
A command that lives only in the menu bar
mistakes.right: Also a shortcut, a toolbar button or the CommandPalette
